recent_fixes_2026_06_02: STRUCT EARNS CLASS-HOOD (78d1b27, madc parser only): teststruct2 SIGSEGV'd because a std::string MEMBER of a struct was never constructed. In C++ a struct IS a class (differ only in default access); the CONTENTS decide object semantics, not the keyword. A struct now stays a DataDefSTRUCT and is PROMOTED to a DataDefCLASS (which is-a DataDefSTRUCT) at the closing `}` when it has an object member by value (is_object(); std::string is an object) -> flows through the existing class member-ctor/RAII-dtor machinery. Trivial structs (no object members) are unchanged. Because only object-having structs promote, trivial C structs (all gcc.c-torture + SMAUG) are untouched -> ZERO regression (the blanket 'every struct is a class' attempts failed at 65-113 regressions by flooding the class path with trivial structs+builtins like __madc_va_list_tag; promotion avoids that). Integration 456->457; torture 1565 zero-regr; SMAUG boots. ~28 lines, no cir_builder/datadef/fork change. NOTE std::string is NOT a trivial struct -- it is_object() (has ctors/dtors/overloads), keeps full object treatment.
